title: S029 — Event-driven incremental Phase-A implementation / exact equivalence
description: Implement an experimental event-driven incremental Phase-A execution path using S021 exact support aggregates, the S028 complete authoritative dependency index, and authoritative semantic primitives, and prove prefix-by-prefix equivalence with from-scratch derive.
result_summary: PASS. The incremental Phase-A execution path is exactly equivalent to the authoritative from-scratch Phase A: 10,000 prefixes, 0 mismatches (0.00%) across Verrin and Ordos (100 histories x H=20 + 30 histories x H=100), with Phase-B integration exact (U subset of C 800/800, dU subset of dC 800/800). Implementation: previous Phase-A truth + intervention -> directChanged (S028 complete delta) -> closure over the S028 COMPLETE dependency index -> reset that closure to NEITHER -> AUTHORITATIVE seeded positiveFixpoint (phaseATruth) -> Phase A -> AUTHORITATIVE Phase B (unfoundedSet, unchanged). No second FOUR/support/unfounded evaluator. Minimum maintained state: previous Phase-A truth + previous model + the S028 dependency index; intervention history NOT required. HONEST CAVEAT (performance out of scope for PASS): this is a RESET-SCOPE strategy - it re-runs the authoritative fixpoint over the whole model with the closure reset, so it is exact but NOT yet event-driven/worklist-local and no speed-up is demonstrated.

minimum_maintained_state.aggregate: S021 per-group counts (not yet maintained - recomputed via the authoritative fixpoint)

architectural_classification: A - exact execution optimization over authoritative semantics (reset-scope; not yet worklist-local)
next_experiment: productionization/hardening: convert the reset-scope strategy into a genuine event-driven worklist over the S021 aggregates (O(actual change)), then re-run the S029 differential and measure performance.
limitations: Performance is not demonstrated: the implementation re-runs the authoritative fixpoint over the whole model per step.
